Com) from University of Mumbai with over 16 years of experience in Accounts, Finance and Taxation. Satyendra Giri is a seasoned professional with over 16 years of extensive experience in the versions industry, particularly within the domains of FinTech, insurance, and broking firms. Throughout his career, he has consistently demonstrated strong leadership, domain expertise, and the ability to drive transformative outcomes in the rapidly evolving BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance) sector.
